title: Bearing Fault Inspection
procedure: Stop the motor using the normal shutdown procedure.
Isolate the motor according to the approved electrical safety procedure.
Inspect the bearing area for abnormal noise, vibration, temperature, or visible damage.
Check lubrication condition and bearing mounting.
Record the observed condition.
Escalate to qualified maintenance personnel if bearing replacement or further mechanical work is required.
warnings: Do not work on an energized motor.
Follow the site's approved isolation procedure.

title: Motor Overheating Inspection
procedure: Stop the motor using the normal shutdown procedure.
Isolate the motor according to the approved electrical safety procedure.
Check the motor temperature.
Inspect ventilation openings and cooling arrangements.
Check for excessive load or abnormal operating conditions.
Record the observations.
Escalate if the cause cannot be safely identified.
warnings: Allow the motor to cool before physical inspection.
Do not touch hot motor surfaces without appropriate protection.
Do not restart until the cause has been evaluated.

title: High Vibration Inspection
procedure: Stop the motor using the normal shutdown procedure.
Isolate the motor according to the approved safety procedure.
Verify the vibration measurement.
Inspect for loose mounting or abnormal mechanical conditions.
Check alignment and coupling condition where applicable.
Record the measurements.
Escalate for detailed mechanical inspection when required.
warnings: Do not inspect rotating components while the motor is running.
Do not operate the motor outside permitted limits.
